summary: Tested the Customer Reviews (shop testimonials) feature on backend and frontend. Backend: 23/23 pytest tests pass (-n0). Public GET /api/testimonials returns only published items, newest first, at most 6, with only the fields id/quote/person/shop. The admin CRUD endpoints return 401 without auth and 403 for merchant or driver tokens. Empty or whitespace-only quote or shop returns 400, a missing field or bad type returns 422, whitespace is collapsed, quote/shop/person are cut to 400/80/60 characters, and a blank person becomes null. PUT or DELETE on an unknown id returns 404. Toggling published hides or shows the review on the public endpoint. Frontend: admin sign-in -> /admin -> admin-reviews-link -> reviews-empty shown; Save is disabled until quote and shop are filled; adding, editing (fields prefilled, cancel shown), hiding/showing, saving a hidden draft and deleting all work, with toasts. Landing: the landing-reviews section is hidden with 0 published reviews. With 3 published it shows quote, shop and optional person cards, stacked at 390px and in 3 columns at 1280px. A hidden review disappears after reload. No console errors. All test testimonials were deleted (db.testimonials is empty; GET /api/testimonials returns []). No drv/trk login_attempts were left.

minor.issue: Text over the length limit is cut silently with no 400 or warning. The UI maxLength stops this in normal use, so this is acceptable as designed. TestimonialIn has no Pydantic max_length, so very large bodies are accepted and then cut.

ui_bugs.issue: review-delete-{id} deletes at once with no confirmation, so one mis-tap permanently loses a real shop quote
If the review currently being edited is deleted, editing/form state is not reset. The next SAVE does a PUT and gets a 404 toast.

issues: Review cards use width 31.5% with gap 16, so the 3-card row ends about 27px short of the container's right edge (1149 vs 1176 at 1280px). It does not line up with the 'Pick your door' cards below. Use flex:1 with flexBasis instead, or compute the width from the gap.
The header subtitle is cut off at 390px ('newest 6 publi…')
The toggle, edit and delete icon Pressables have no accessibilityLabel

action_items: Optional: add a confirm step (or undo toast) before deleting a review
Optional: reset editing/form state when the review being edited is deleted
Optional: make the landing review cards fill the container width on wide screens (flex:1 instead of 31.5%)
Optional: add accessibilityLabel to the review toggle, edit and delete icon buttons
critical_code_review_comments: The backend implementation is clean: _id is excluded, the ADMIN_ONLY dependency is used, and the public projection keeps fields minimal
If /api/testimonials fails, the landing section stays hidden silently. That fits a trust section.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ and TEST_UI testimonials during testing; all were deleted afterwards (db.testimonials count = 0)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run tests/test_testimonials.py with -n0. conftest auto-auth does not cover /api/admin/testimonials, so the tests send explicit tokens with X-No-Auto-Auth. The module fixture cleans up docs whose shop starts with TEST_. db.login_attempts holds older probe@x.io and x@y.z keys that this iteration did not create.
